headline: Ticketmaster has not said what caused its Nov 20 outage. Nobody has claimed or reported a hack.
summary: First draft. 9 sources (1 Tier 1, 7 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 15 claims (2 Confirmed, 9 Reported, 1 Rumor, 3 Not established), 7 questions. The Friday outage at the Caesars Superdome is Confirmed by the organizer's and the venue manager's own statements. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. An anonymous 'probing' comment is carried as a Rumor with no evidence. The Nov 19 South Dakota disruption rests on one outlet. The brief's 'mostly fixed by about 10 PM ET' became about 10:30 PM ET because the venue's times are Central.
